name: Falrok
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

generalAbilities.name: Lazurite-Infused Flesh
generalAbilities.description: Falrok's flesh is infused with lazurite, and he gains the benefits undead creatures gain from this mineral at all times. When in an area infused with lazurite, such as the Sanctum of the Starved, these benefits increase to a +3 circumstance bonus to saving throws against vitality effects. This infusion also grants Falrok his resistance to vitality damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Opportune Backstab
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within Falrok's melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of his allies.

Effect When Falrok's enemy is hit by one of his allies, he capitalizes upon the distraction, making a Strike against the triggering creature.

defensiveAbilities.name: Stench
defensiveAbilities.description:
10 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1 (plus Slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure).

While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Effect: Stench

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Falrok is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

Effect Falrok devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 8d6 Healing Damage Hit Points.

He can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ghast Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 3d8 Void Damage damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 3d8 Void Damage damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Ghast the next midnight

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: Any living creature hit by a ghast's attack must succeed at a DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Scoundrel
offensiveAbilities.description: When Falrok successfully Feints, the target is Off-Guard against melee attacks he attempts against it until the end of his next turn. On a critical success, the target is off-guard against all melee attacks until the end of their next turn, not just Falrok's.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Falrok deal 4d6 extra precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swift Leap
offensiveAbilities.description: Falrok jumps up to half his Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
